# v1.0.0 — Windows 虚拟化诊断与配置管理

VM Identity Lab 首个正式版，提供本地虚拟化证据分析、VMX只读查看、宿主/客户机报告对比、默认脱敏JSON/HTML、有限官方API配置事务与恢复，以及私有三阶段身份验证。支持简体中文和英文，默认普通用户权限，无遥测。

本版统一程序集和界面为1.0.0，采用.NET10 LTS/WPF；自包含运行时与Windows采集依赖更新为10.0.14。原有报告schema和配置准入保持，旧v0.2/v0.3预发布资产不变。

## 下载与验证

完整解压Windows x64 ZIP，运行`VMIdentityLab.App.exe`，无需开发SDK、系统.NET或Python。保留全部运行时文件。可下载ZIP摘要及逐文件摘要核对完整性。

来源：`8c30801ca4974910d513bb0a454733f9b452fd8f`；[主线CI40894459119](https://github.com/Aleka579/VMIL/actions/runs/40894459119)实际通过240单元/206模拟集成，失败/跳过0、Release零警告/错误。SDK10.0.403，两自包含运行时10.0.14。413文件/65,286,472字节原CI ZIP，不重建或重压缩。目标验收及发布回执见[本版记录](https://github.com/Aleka579/VMIL/blob/main/docs/V1-RELEASE.md)。

同一新原包已通过Windows11 Pro Build26100/x64普通权限验收：部署6/6、CLI/PNG28/28、正常双语App50/50，App真实退出0；标准目录和命令中未发现系统SDK/.NET，实际加载包内运行时。该目标是现有系统，并非全新OS。有限写入保留M11/M12原模块实测范围，本轮新包仅作只读客户机验收，未修改真实VM配置。

## 已准入配置范围

内存/CPU仅限Workstation17.5.2 build23775571、hardware19、每插槽2核、4096↔6144MiB及2↔4vCPU。已有静态MAC/BIOS UUID操作还要求同一精确vmrest构建、两标识有效、唯一静态hostonly网卡且启动断开；一次一个已有字段。未知/运行/挂起/占用/旧预览/未决操作拒绝写入，应用和恢复均需完全关机、明确确认、备份、持久记录和API复核。App不管理电源、不直接替换VMX；参数备份不是整机恢复，本地租约不是VMware全局锁。

Windows10/11 x64按实际Build记录兼容性；新包、历史模块、上游支持及未知范围分开。全新OS、其他VMware构建/拓扑及联网未验证，自动地址/缺失键/厂商生成或复制不开放。私有快照含原始MAC/UUID，禁止公开上传。其他虚拟化证据仍然存在，不保证第三方程序识别为物理机，不用于绕过反作弊、反欺诈、封禁、授权或安全保护。

## English

The first stable VM Identity Lab release provides local virtualization diagnostics, VMX inspection, redacted report comparison/export, finite official-API configuration transactions and restoration, and private three-stage identity validation. Chinese/English UI, ordinary-user operation, no telemetry. Version1.0.0 uses .NET10 LTS/WPF with bundled runtimes and Windows collection packages10.0.14. Existing schemas and write admission remain unchanged.

The original main-branch CI artifact is preserved byte for byte: source8c30801, [CI40894459119](https://github.com/Aleka579/VMIL/actions/runs/40894459119), SDK10.0.403, zero build warnings/errors,240 unit/206 synthetic integration tests passed without failures/skips. The ZIP has413 files and65,286,472 bytes; download it with the ZIP and per-file SHA256 assets. No system SDK, .NET or Python is needed. Exact target acceptance is documented in the release record.

This exact new artifact passed6 deployment,28 CLI/PNG and50 bilingual normal-App checks on an ordinary-user Windows11 Pro build26100 x64 guest, with actual exit code0 and bundled runtime loading. No system .NET/SDK was found in the checked standard paths/command. This is an existing OS, not a fresh installation. Finite-write evidence retains the earlier M11/M12 module scope; this package received read-only guest acceptance without real VM configuration changes.

Writes retain the exact Workstation17.5.2 build23775571/hardware19 profile:4096↔6144MiB and2↔4vCPU, two cores per socket. One existing static MAC or BIOS UUID requires the exact vmrest build, both valid identities and one static host-only NIC disconnected at startup. Power-off, fresh preview, explicit confirmation, verified backup, durable intent and API readback are required. Backups restore parameters rather than the entire VM, and the App lease is not a global VMware lock.

Other builds/topologies, automatic or missing identities, generated/copied workflows, networking and fresh OS environments remain outside verified scope. Private snapshots contain raw identifiers: keep them private. Other virtualization evidence remains; physical-machine classification is not guaranteed. Do not evade anti-cheat, anti-fraud, bans, licensing or security protections. MIT, Copyright(c)2026 Daniel Waltz; retain third-party notices. Use the private security channel for vulnerabilities.
